reviews.review:
Bland and boring. I beat all the campaign maps before looking at "sandbox", which was as bare bones as possible; either replay the campaign level or survive for some time. 

There isn't an ability to tweak income rate nor set up your own scenarios. All you literally do is spawn random units and hope you overwhelm the enemy AI with numbers. There isn't clear "Rock-Paper-Scissors" balancing act, where spears beat horses, archers beat spears, etc... It just feels random. Why use "Brute" (whatever that is) when it dies extremely fast and I can spawn horses that tank almost everything? Why even have a Ballista when just 2 or 3 horses will reach it and kill it within a second? 

You got the spawning mechanic, great, why stop there? Why can't I tell my units to stay in an area? Why Can't i set up defenses? Why can't i build a wall? (no, not the barrier). . I was hoping this would be like another silly Totally Accurate Battle Simulator with base attacking, but even THAT was too high of expectations I guess. 

Yes, I know it was made by one guy. Cool. That doesn't change anything at all. This needed very little to turn it from meh to actually fun. It's not an excuse to release something half baked. He chose to release it as is.
